## `src/reports.js`
The `overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf)` function that:
- Filters invoices with status `'issued'` or `'partially_paid'`
- Keeps only those with `dueDate` before the `asOf` reference date
- Returns an array of `{ number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due }` objects
- Sorts results by `daysOverdue` descending (most overdue first)
- Calculates `daysOverdue` using `daysBetween()` and `due` using `balanceDue()`

## `test/reports.test.js`
17 comprehensive tests covering:
- Basic functionality with issued and partially paid invoices
- Status filtering (excluding draft and paid invoices)
- Date filtering (excluding not-yet-due and same-day due invoices)
- Sorting by overdue days
- Due amount calculation with VAT and discounts
- Multiple payment handling
- Edge cases (empty arrays, no mutations, old due dates)

All 181 tests in the test suite pass.
